items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Harry James, Ziggy Elman, everybody. ... we had some good times on the set with Buck Clayton, Ziggy Elman, Harry James.

ctx.x: Yeah, so it was like, everybody was what they call lip syncing I guess, right?
Correct, sure. Harry James, Ziggy Elman, everybody.
You were in a movie yourself, weren’t you, “Carnegie Hall?”
